purpose: Test whether the packet detector's run-level decision agrees with an INDEPENDENT, receiver-measured pre-action impact label, across a graded jitter sweep that includes levels between the two S14 settings. The impact label is produced by ptp4l, not by the detector.
development_exclusion: The impact measure and its threshold were DERIVED FROM S14 data. S14, S11, S12 and all V1-V5 runs are therefore development data and are excluded from S15 estimation. S15 runs are the independent test set and must not be used to retune anything.
why_a_new_protocol_is_required: A decision rule tuned on S14 cannot be validated on S14. This protocol fixes labels, measurement, analysis and criteria before any S15 data exists.

frozen_rule.detector_note: Eight matched Sync/Follow_Up arrival-gap samples per block; two high, disjoint blocks within three seconds. Blocks need not be consecutive. 160 us is provisional engineering configuration, not a validated harm boundary.

topology: Two independent L2 bridges, one master per segment, one slaveOnly ptp4l with a port on each. Identical to S14. A run whose receiver enters MASTER on either port is recorded UNKNOWN.
why_these_levels: Mean delay is held at 100 us in every arm so it cannot separate conditions; only configured jitter varies. j020 and j200 reproduce the two S14 settings; j060, j100 and j140 lie between them so the decision boundary is not pre-baked into the design.
ordering: Six repetitions; within each repetition the five levels run in fixed ascending order.

independent_impact_label.source: ptp4l receiver servo summary line in slave.log, field `delay <mean> +/- <dispersion>`, ns
independent_impact_label.quantity: the maximum dispersion among servo samples recorded after the netem apply event
independent_impact_label.timing_basis: Servo lines and port-state transitions share the ptp4l log timebase. No mapping to capture or detector clocks is assumed and no cross-timebase duration is computed.
independent_impact_label.threshold_provenance: Midpoint of the S14 development separation: benign dispersion maximum 24615 ns and jitter-fault minimum 33330 ns. Derived from development data; S15 is its first independent test. It is an engineering decision boundary, NOT a harm boundary.
independent_impact_label.label_rule: IMPACTED if max post-apply dispersion >= 29000 ns, NOT_IMPACTED if < 29000 ns
independent_impact_label.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN if no servo sample exists after the netem apply event, if the receiver entered MASTER on either port, if the run is unsealed, or if any manifest hash mismatches. UNKNOWN runs are reported and excluded from agreement statistics, never silently dropped.

detector_decision: Per run: did the live detector record a detection_trigger event. Nothing else.

analysis.primary: 2x2 agreement between the independent impact label and the detector decision, over all runs labelled IMPACTED or NOT_IMPACTED
report: sensitivity and specificity with Wilson 95% intervals
per-condition detector trigger rate and impact rate
every UNKNOWN run with its reason
the dispersion value of every run
analysis.no_retuning: No threshold, condition, label rule or exclusion may change after the first S15 run. If the result is poor, it is reported as poor.

prespecified_interpretation.sensitivity_and_specificity_both_at_leas: the detector's run-level decision agrees with the independent receiver-measured impact label across the sweep
prespecified_interpretation.high_sensitivity_low_specificity: the detector triggers on jitter levels the receiver measure does not mark impacted; report the levels where they diverge
prespecified_interpretation.low_sensitivity_high_specificity: the detector misses impacted runs; report the levels where it misses
prespecified_interpretation.agreement_no_better_than_the_majority_la: the detector decision is not shown to track the independent impact measure
prespecified_interpretation.all_or_nearly_all_runs_UNKNOWN: the measurement plan failed; report it as a failed validation attempt and do not substitute another label source

failure_and_exclusion_handling: Preserve every attempt including failures. Never delete or rename a run directory. A trial that dies is retained with its reason and counted as UNKNOWN.
decision_boundary: S15 can establish only whether a packet-level decision agrees with a receiver-measured protocol degradation in this software testbed. It cannot establish harm, service impact, physical timing accuracy, attack detection, recovery benefit, or O-RAN conformance. Harmfulness remains UNKNOWN: no service requirement has been specified against which a path-delay dispersion could be judged harmful.
supersede_reason: Receiver statistic was a maximum over an unspecified number of summary windows while the boundary was derived from a single window; no phase-alignment rule; harm-sounding labels; fixed ascending trial order. No S15 run existed at supersession.
